definitions.explanation: Liquid discharge from the nose, typically due to a cold, allergies, or irritation.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}をひいて{鼻水|はなみず}が{止|と}まらない。
examples.english: I caught a cold and can't stop my runny nose.

examples.japanese: {鼻水|はなみず}をティッシュで{拭|ふ}いた。
examples.english: I wiped my runny nose with a tissue.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}で{鼻水|はなみず}と{目|め}の{痒|かゆ}みがひどい。
examples.english: My runny nose and itchy eyes are bad due to hay fever.

notes:
{鼻水|はなみず} refers to nasal discharge (runny nose).

Common expressions:
- {鼻水|はなみず}が{出|で}る (to have a runny nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}が{止|と}まらない (can't stop one's runny nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}を{拭|ふ}く (to wipe one's nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}を{垂|た}らす (to have a dripping nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}をすする (to sniff/sniffle)
- {鼻|はな}をかむ (to blow one's nose)

Related symptoms:
- くしゃみ (sneezing)
- {鼻|はな}づまり (stuffy nose)
- {咳|せき} (cough)

Note:
{鼻水|はなみず} is a common symptom of both colds ({風邪|かぜ}) and allergies ({花粉症|かふんしょう}). The word literally means "nose water." More formal or medical terms include {鼻汁|びじゅう}.
